function.arguments: {"observation": "`patient_id` has 48 duplicate values, indicating that some patients appear more than once in the dataset — specifically, 48 patients are re-tested and appear twice, once for each `sample_seq`.", "implication": "The dataset contains multiple rows per patient. If we compute the mean on the raw rows, we would double-weight the patients who were re-tested. To compute the mean per patient, we must deduplicate on `patient_id`, keeping only the row with the highest `sample_seq` for each patient. Otherwise, the mean will be biased toward the re-tested patients."}
function.name: note_finding
